newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts GOs repriced/restructured, ylds cut.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts GOs repriced/restructured, ylds cut.

text.p: Goldman, Sachs & Co. said Wednesday it repriced and restructured Massachusetts $549 million GO deal. Increasing the size to $627 million while cutting yields in several maturities.
THE COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS RE: $627,310,000* VERBAL AWARD. PLEASE NOTE REPRICING AND RESTRUCTURING.
GENERAL OBLIGATION REFUNDING BONDS 1997 SERIES A
MOODY'S: A1 S&P: A+ FITCH: A+
GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS CONSOLIDATED LOAN OF 1997, SERIES C MOODY'S: A1 S&P: A+ FITCH: A+

EXCEPT: 08/01/2010C - 08/01/2011C: NON CALLABLE * - APPROXIMATE SUBJECT TO CHANGE The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply. The award is expected Thursday, July 24, 1997.
